base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(COUNT(b.XCL_001) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT u.XCL_055)
FROM users u
JOIN badges b ON b.XCL_002 = u.XCL_052
WHERE u.XCL_060 > 200;

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(badge_count) AS average_badges
FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(b.XCL_001) AS badge_count
    FROM users u
    JOIN badges b ON u.XCL_052 = b.XCL_002
    WHERE u.XCL_060 > 200
    GROUP BY u.XCL_052
)
